sections.content: Recall Van + possessive suffix means 'has' (Unit 6). Use it for hair color too: haj (hair) plus the possessive -a gives haja van, 'his/her hair is there' — meaning 'has hair.'
sections.title: Hair color

sections.content: This is the same 'have' pattern from Unit 6 (Van egy testvérem) — here haj (hair) takes the possessive suffix -a instead.
